Adding and editing contacts

Güven Phone Help Guide, version 2.0.22

On the Contacts tab, tap Add new contact (with a screen reader, double-tap).

The form has these sections: Name information, Phone, Email, Birthday, Work information and Account. Only the first name is required.

Add phone number opens a new number row. In the Number type picker choose Mobile, Home, Work, Other or Custom; with Custom you type your own label.

For a birthday you choose the day and month; the year is optional.

Change the value of the birthday, number type and account pickers by swiping up or down with your screen reader, or with Previous option and Next option in the actions menu.

The keyboard’s Next key takes you to the next field.

When you are done, tap Save contact. If the number is already in your contacts, you are offered Open existing contact or Save anyway.

To change an existing contact, tap Edit in its details. If the contact is saved in more than one source, you are asked which record to edit.
